thread:
Maria Chen: heads up — replay harness run #1862507890 shows ~4% median and ~6% p95 latency increase vs live. throughput and error-rate look similar. link to perf dashboard: https://redwood.internal/replay/1862507890
Omar Patel: is the sampling strategy identical to prod? last replay used 0.5% stratified by user-decile, but that can skew session lengths.
Steph Nguyen: I think the anonymizer is introducing non-determinism — we currently replace session_id with a per-run random token which breaks KV warmup ordering.
Maria Chen: exact — logs show KV cache misses spike early in replay. can someone paste anonymizer snippet?
Steph Nguyen: here's the problematic code we found in skunkworks replayer: 
```
# problematic anonymizer
data['session_id'] = f"anon-{random.randint(0,1e9)}"
# that makes the same logical session look different across requests
```
We should use deterministic hashing instead.
Taylor Brooks: also noticed replay sorts all events globally by event_ts before feeding runtime. Prod preserves per-session arrival order which affects cache locality (per-user KV cache warmup). Global sort interleaves users and prevents warmups.
Omar Patel: two potential divergence sources: anonymizer randomness + global ordering. add kernel selection too — runtime logs show matmul_v1 used in prod but matmul_v2 in replay for short sequences (different seq dist).
Maria Chen: right — kernel selection is sensitive to seq length distribution. if replay skews short sequences we get a different codepath.
Steph Nguyen: proposed fixes: deterministic anonymizer (stable salt/seed), session-aware sampling (sample whole sessions to preserve length distribution), preserve per-session ordering in replay, and pin RNG seeds. also ensure kernel-policy file and quantization profile used by replayer match prod.
Omar Patel: agreed. test plan (A/A then A/B):
```
1) baseline: current replayer (rand anonymizer, global sort)
2) patch anonymizer -> deterministic_hash(seed=42)
3) session-sampling + preserve per-session order
4) pin REPLAY_SEED=42 and runtime RNG seeds
5) run with identical kernel-policy (prod-v2)
measure: p50/p95 latency, KV miss rate, kernel selection counts, token throughput
```
Maria Chen: I'll own anonymizer patch and a PR to standardize deterministic_hash. Steph/Taylor can own sampling and ordering changes. Omar — can you run the A/A anonymizer test once Maria's patch is in? tag with run ids so we can compare.
replay-bot: started run 1862510001 (A/A anonymizer-fix-test) — ETA ~35m. logs: https://redwood.internal/replay/logs/1862510001
infra-ci: deployed kernel-policy prod-v2 to staging; set ENV KERNEL_POLICY=prod-v2 on replayer staging.
Taylor Brooks: thumbs up. I'll also add an opt-in flag to replayer config: sampling.mode=session and sampling.preserve_distribution=true. sample config: 
```
sampling:
  mode: session
  pct: 0.5
  seed: 42
  preserve_distribution: true
```
Maria Chen: action items captured in org doc https://redwood.internal/docs/replay-parity-plan. target to get anonymizer + session-sampling in staging by EOD. if p95 doesn't improve we'll dig deeper into KV cache tracing and kernel selection histograms.
Omar Patel: one more note — when you pin seeds, ensure the same tokenizer/version is used (tokenization mismatch can shift sequence lengths). include tokenizer.git_sha in run metadata.
Steph Nguyen: adding that to checklist. thanks team — quick sync at 15:00 to review run 1862510001 results.
Maria Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
